req.title: Reject invalid status code
req.statement: The system shall return HTTP 400 when the status code path segment is not a valid integer.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /status/<non-integer> must return HTTP 400. The source code in view_status_code() catches ValueError from int(codes) and returns Response('Invalid status code', status=400). Tests must: (1) confirm a valid integer code returns the correct status (positive/EP), (2) confirm a purely alphabetic segment returns 400 with exact body text (negative/NEG), (3) probe boundary inputs like empty-ish strings, mixed alphanumeric, and special characters (boundary/BVA), and (4) confirm the exact response body text to kill constant-mutation and string-mutation operators. Each test uses the in-process Flask test client to avoid live URLs.

tests.name: test_valid_integer_status_code_returns_200
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 200
trace: R-HTTPBIN-015: valid integer path segment must NOT trigger the 400 error path
Catches mutations that flip the ValueError branch to always return 400
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_valid_integer_status_code_returns_200():
    r = client.get('/status/200')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.status_code != 400

tests.name: test_response_body_exact_text_on_invalid_code
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Inspect both status code and body bytes exactly
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 400
Response body bytes equal b'Invalid status code' exactly (no extra whitespace or different casing)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-015: exact body text must be 'Invalid status code'
NEG + constant-mutation: kills mutations that change the error string or status constant
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_response_body_exact_text_on_invalid_code():
    r = client.get('/status/xyz')
    assert r.status_code == 400
    body = r.data
    assert body == b'Invalid status code'
    assert body != b''
    assert body != b'invalid status code'
    assert body != b'Invalid Status Code'
